question:
I'm trying to create a variable that's the number of months between today and '2019-01-01', and then use that number in a loop range.

I've read this post, but still can't get it to work for some reason.

{%- call statement('test', fetch_result=True) -%}
      SELECT DATEDIFF('month', CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE), CAST(NOW() AS DATE)) as months
      FROM {{ ref('my_table') }} LIMIT 1

{%- endcall -%}

{%- set num_months = load_result('test')['data'][0][0] -%}

SELECT
    {% for month_offset in range(0, num_months) %}
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS month_{{ month_offset + 1 }}{% if not loop.last %},
        {% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
FROM {{ ref('my_table') }} LIMIT 1

SQL Fluffer picks up an error at the very beginning "Unrecoverable failure in Jinja templating: sqlfluff.core.templaters.jinja.UndefinedRecorder object has no element 0."

And when i run the code, I get: TypeError: 'Undefined' object cannot be interpreted as an integer

i tried doing run_query too:

{% set num_months = run_query("SELECT DATEDIFF('month', CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE), CAST(NOW() AS DATE))
      FROM {{ ref('dim_product') }} LIMIT 1") %}
title: How to use a SELECT statement to set a variable in DBT that is later used in a FOR loop?
answer:
As answered on GetDBT Slack channel by Owen:

{% set now = modules.datetime.datetime.now() %}
{% set reference_dt = modules.datetime.datetime(2019, 1, 1) %}
{% set num_months = ( (now.year - reference_dt.year)*12 + now.month - reference_dt.month ) %}

SELECT
    {% for month_offset in range(0, num_months) %}
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS month_{{ month_offset + 1 }}{% if not loop.last %},
        {% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
FROM {{ ref('my_table') }} LIMIT 1
